instructions.tail: Codex CLI: no brief is injected, so run `vaultctl.py session-brief` once for continuity. Checkpoint on this session's rollout in `~/.codex/sessions/` and take the model from its `turn_context.model`.

notes: User skills are $HOME/.agents/skills per developers.openai.com/codex/skills (checked 2026-10-18); earlier releases installed ~/.codex/skills, which is refreshed in place when present and never created. Hooks arrive in milestone 3.
